meta.title: Session migration
meta.description: In Settings → Session migration, manage old sessions with two tabs: Sessions to migrate and Migrated sessions. The range supports 0–120, defaulting to 1 month ago; 0 means all sessions including this month, with 1/3/6-month and all-sessions quick ranges. Sessions with a note or todo are kept by default and must be explicitly allowed and selected. Both tabs group by workspace and then by last activity month, with workspaces and months collapsed by default, showing Git branch, parent session, note/todo text and DSH archive state. The default archive directory is $DSH_HOME/session-migrator/archive; another absolute directory can be entered manually.
